This is a within-gSDE timing comparison, not a matched Gaussian-versus-gSDE algorithm comparison.
Resampling changes both heading and speed noise persistence; it does not isolate heading alone.
SB3 resamples at rollout starts as well as at the configured interval. State-dependent noise can change with observations even while its matrix is held.
The noise matrix weight std is .01, not the marginal action standard deviation.
The current input-scaling study is separate: both timing arms retain original coordinate scale and GAE lambda .95.
Fixed route/static support stays on; aircraft conflict filtering stays off.
Classical results are the preserved Windows benchmark from an earlier evaluator source.
Unseen and official streams remain reserved; no competition readiness claim.
